reply_text:
I replied to Marcus in your DM: he should keep **Tuesday, Nov 10 at 10:15** free.

- **Where that comes from:** On Oct 14, Marcus told me in this DM that his standing call with the Tamsin Cold Chain team for the Driftwood rollout had moved to Tuesdays at 10:15. I haven't seen anything since that changes it.
- **Not on his calendar:** His calendar has no Driftwood event, and nothing at all for Nov 9–13. I suggested he add the call so nobody books over that slot. I didn't change his calendar myself.

I only used what Marcus could see himself, and the 10:15 time came from his own DM with me.
